# Framer — Framer startups program

A full year of the Framer Pro plan at no cost, stated by Framer as a $360 saving, for pre-seed or seed startups backed by a Framer approved partner that have not used Framer before.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🎨 Design](../categories/design.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | free plan |
| **Maximum** | $360 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |


### Not covered

- Startups that have previously used Framer
- Startups not backed by a Framer approved partner

### Notes

The page prints no formal program name; its own wording is "Apply for the startups program". The application form's Employees dropdown offers only the values 2 through 10, and the Stage dropdown offers only Pre-seed and Seed - these are form constraints rather than stated rules, so employees_max is left null. The Country dropdown enumerates ~35 countries but also offers "Other", so it is not a stated geographic restriction. The approved-partner list lives at https://www.framer.com/startups/vc-partners/ (200). Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
